censusVerification.scope: Snapshot of every row in BIVB's public Rully directory. Includes local estates, outside producers, négociants, cooperatives and sales/visitor entries. 68 rows are not 68 independent estates or 68 complete profiles. The directory omits existing verified Rully producers Jean-Baptiste Ponsot and Domaine Saint-Jacques. Wine technical sheets are label-level baselines unless a vintage is explicitly recorded.

technicalLimitations: No dated analytical data or confirmed photo reuse permissions were available for every new wine; no such claims were invented.
David Lefort's own product pages identify bottles, grapes and vintages but do not publish full vinification specifications. La Chaume 2019 importer specifications are retained separately.
Sylvain & Lucie Ponsot's portfolio distinguishes multiple vessels for Vauvry; these are separate cuvées, not duplicate names.
Renaissance French primary technical sheets are used for farming/identity: the English promotional text's unsupported biodynamic wording is not adopted.
Census types combine BIVB business categories with explicit entity names. A tasting cellar label alone does not establish the business owns vineyards.
